scientific_integrity.claim_scope: Asymptotic unstandardized third cumulant per unit time of planar displacement projections for Poisson orientation resets to zero, with positive speed, rotational diffusivity, reset rate and nonnegative independent translational diffusion.
limitations: Not a finite-time standardized skewness theorem
Not a first-passage or large-deviation result
Prior exact intermediate scattering functions implicitly determine all joint cumulants; independent publication-priority validation remains outstanding.
scientific_integrity.mathematical_evidence: Generator/Poisson-resolvent third cumulant tensor, rational factorization, cubic threshold and unique angular optimizer. Standalone checker performs 25 independent symbolic and numerical diagnostics.

title: A sharp off-axis third-cumulant transition for orientationally reset active Brownian motion
